title: National Design Studio and Cognition Launch 6 Month Government Residency
summary:
Applications are now open for American Forge, a fellowship designed to place elite software engineers in federal roles. The program, run by National Design Studio in partnership with Cognition, is a 6 month residency for technologists to address technical challenges and modernize the software of America.

Cognition executive Paul Grewal stated the residency allows a new generation of technologists to complete a public service tour in 6 months that previously required 6 years. The initiative targets engineers capable of solving the most difficult problems within the US government.
